correctness.rationale: Reconstruction verifies the five-vertex edge graph is complete minus apex-apex, odd crossing parity equals apex separation, the invariant-plane denominator is 4D, and the six-sided offset interval is the positive part of equatorial median minus apex height. Exact spherical angular primitives give P6, apex-deletion support differences give P3, and normalization plus parity give P4 and P5. Since D' increases from zero to pi, Q=D-(h+3sqrt(3)/4)D' decreases across zero exactly once. Standalone independent midpoint edge enumeration agrees at six aspect ratios (24 distribution comparisons plus six local-optimum comparisons), but finite checks do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The complete exact four-type affine-plane section distribution for a natural family of triangular bipyramids determines otherwise non-obvious section frequencies and an interior, uniquely optimal pentagon-producing geometry. That optimizer differs from the equilateral-faced Johnson solid. The proof combines a graph-parity identity, support deficits, and median angular integration; the result is useful as an exact geometric-probability benchmark for section-type tomography, not merely a finite enumeration.
